philippines-solar.sourceNote: Typical-shape fallback: IEMOP RTD endpoint exposes current-day dispatch schedules, not curtailed-energy. The 2% rate previously applied was an invented placeholder with no published source. Provisional anchor from IRENA Philippines RE Statistics 2024 (~0.04 TWh/yr solar + ~0.02 TWh/yr wind). Held at T3 until IEMOP/WESM publishes a citable renewable-curtailment rate.
